To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) a new image formation and alignment energy are introduced that enable fully automatic markerless motion capture of general human shapes from video, (2) the new energy is used to optimize a new statistical human shape and pose model, and (3) the model is optimized in an iterative process that jointly estimates the actor’s shape, appearance, skeleton, and motion from multi-view footage.

(1) a novel volumetric image formation model can be used for human shape and motion capture; (2) this model enables a new alignment energy that can be efficiently optimized; (3) this alignment energy enables fully automatic human shape and motion estimation; and (4) the proposed statistical body model can represent the body surface, body shape variability, and skeleton shape variability.

we propose a fully-automatic method that jointly creates a 3D model of an actor’s body and motion from multi-view footage and that we propose a new image formation and alignment model that is analytically differentable, which allows for efficient and accurate optimization.
